convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import (../../../design-system/in-progress/hemlock-library.lib.pen) and the fonts (../../fonts/) resolve. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (all 15 frames hash-identical, all 15 distinct).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-pen budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, per-state contract roots (#componentCard / #scXmBack .sc-modal / .lpps-xm .sc-modal / .lpz-back .sc-modal), Chromium via playwright 1.49 headless (Chrome Headless Shell 151.0.7922.34), deviceScaleFactor 2, viewport 1280x1400 (contract storyViewport). Protocol: all non-local origins blocked + @font-face injection serving Heebo/Noto Serif (+italic) from the SAME repo TTFs the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/); --font-render-hinting=none --disable-font-subpixel-positioning --disable-lcd-text; transitions/animations frozen, caret hidden; fresh context per state; pointer parked at the corner after steps EXCEPT scrub-age-60 (pointerMoveToCoordinates — pointer owns the state) and help-tooltip-open (#astraHelpBubble hides on pointerout of its badge, source ~3229 — pointer rests on the clicked badge); INTEGER-CSS-PIXEL clip of the contract root via page.screenshot clip, self-consistency gate (two consecutive shots byte-equal); scene extraction runs in the SAME session as the banked target (the interview layout jitters sub-pixel between loads — async engine re-render timing).
iterationNotes: R1 (7/15 <= 1.0%): geometry/type/color converged at first transcription for the wizard modals; the six card states failed on a systematic 1-device-px shift, thumbs, scrub dash, gauge ring details.
R2 (14/15): blanket +0.5 css registration offset on card states — diagnostic only, over-shifted header/text content.

R3 (14/15, one regression): transform-layer snap model — wrong lead; identity-transform carousel shifts turned out to be per-BOX paint snapping; wizard-assumptions regressed on a spurious layer delta; scenes moved into the target session after proving between-session sub-pixel layout jitter in the interview.
R4 (15/15 <= 1.03%, one marginal): per-box integer-CSS-px edge snapping (boxes/inputs/clips/svg roots snap, text stays subpixel) — reproduces every measured Chromium paint position.

R5 (15/15 <= 0.81%, final): empirical per-(family|size|weight|style) pen-vs-Chromium text-y calibration table (25 combos, 0 or 1 css px); slider thumb pseudo-box geometry (top = trackTop - 6). A post-convergence tooling-defect fix (the authored example-arc pathLength/dasharray trim never executed — template-literal escaping ate the regex backslashes) landed the trimmed 55% arc and dropped gauge-explainer-open 0.66% -> 0.196%; per the loop rules tooling failures consume no iteration budget. Worst state 0.807% (explainer-open), median 0.24%.
convergence.geometryProbesRun: contract-named vectors verified against the emitted frames (the direct geometry source): THE MARKER LAW — retire marker M-x 307.2 (plan-default) / 204.8 (slider-save-offered), longevity 819.2, bound $chart-ramp/hue-03-green and $y:chart-threshold (the spouse-state vectors 295.3846/925.5384 apply to the card BEHIND the wizard modal root — outside that frame's clip by contract); gauge band annulus innerRadius 0.8039 (mask 82/102), sweep 132.48deg = 55% of the 240deg dial, from-angle 240; scrub panel 180px wide radius-2xs; card frame 1024 wide; slider fills at the live gradient fractions (log-slider law positions 516/435/522/232, 630 after PageUp); frame dims = integer-snapped contract-root clips. All pass.
